name: FlyByWire A320neo（2020 legacy / DDS）
notes: 2020 legacy(DDS) 模式：需要安装 FlyByWire A320neo（flybywire-aircraft-a320-neo）。生成变体目录 SimObjects/AirPlanes/FBW_A320_NEO-<ICAO码>，base_container 指向 ..\FlyByWire_A320_NEO；贴图为 *.PNG.DDS + .DDS.json + texture.CFG + thumbnail*.jpg。对应真实包 flybywire-aircraft-a320-neo-livery-CHH。
aircraft_cfg_template:
[VERSION]
major = 1
minor = 0

[VARIATION]
base_container = "{base_container}"

;===================== FLTSIM =====================

[FLTSIM.0]
title = "{title}" ; Variation name
texture = "{texture}" ; texture folder
ui_variation = "{ui_variation}" ; e.g. World Air, IFR Panel
atc_id = "{atc_id}" ; tail number
atc_id_enable = 0 ; enable tail number
atc_airline = "{atc_airline}" ; airline name
atc_flight_number = "{atc_flight_number}" ; flight number
icao_airline = "{icao_airline}"
